With a=e^-t,b_i=e^-(d_i+1)t,c=e^-(k+1)t, signed heat-row difference has single definite positive mass at hub/other blades and deficits in the selected blade by monotonicity of (1-e^-xt)/x. Explicit optimal couplings and 1-Lipschitz dual potentials yield exact W1: within blade b_i, across blades 2a, hub to blade c+2(k-d_i)(a-c)/k. Edge W1 duality yields sharp Lip(H_t)=c+2(k-s)(a-c)/k. Calculus proves strict contraction for all t>0 iff k<=2s+1 when m>=2, else one positive-time peak; for m=1 formula collapses to e^-(k+1)t. Independent numerical matrix exponential and Kantorovich dual linear programs checked all pairs and relevant edge norms on profiles (1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,3),(1,1,4),(2,2,2) and t=0,.4,1.6, with no mismatches. Arbitrary integer profiles/all real t follow analytically, not by extrapolation.
